CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   C. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   B. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

10. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.

11. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   D. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain A friend at Midnight and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church 3 4.2 The Lords Supper 3 4.3 The Holy Spirit 3 4.4 Peter Miracu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Lord’s Supper and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. C — Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of A friend at Midnight; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Early Church; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
